pages.html:
About This Edition

This edition is written for students who already know how to read short, simple words and are ready to master advanced spelling patterns. The beginning-reader phonics primer (letter sounds, blending, sight words) has been removed, since it is not needed at this level.

Every lesson follows the same 7-stage sequence, and every stage has its own fixed color and icon so you always know exactly where you are:

📋 1. Word List
🗂 2. Word Sort
📖 3. Word Meaning
🗣 4. Reading Fluency
✏ 5. Proofreading
🧩 6. Phonetic & Decoding
✍ 7. Working Space
